source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all five Rancho Coronado rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. The district's source-defined water trade is retained as local commerce while production sites, ruins, housing and gang-internal stores remain non-retail context. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only.

entities.name: Albino Alligator Car Wash
entities.source_summary: Albino Alligators headquarters built around one of Rancho Coronado's few dependable water sources; locals obtain buckets of somewhat clean water here and the gang deliberately avoids abusive pricing.

local_offerings.label: Buckets of somewhat clean drinking water

entities.name: Bread and Roses
entities.source_summary: Dirty Hippies headquarters and ganga-growing, drying and packing site that hires local labor; the source does not establish a customer-facing sales point at the location itself.

entities.name: Digital Divinity Ruins
entities.source_summary: Dangerous crater and ruin associated with rumors about the destroyed Digital Divinity experiment rather than an active commercial operation.

entities.name: Eagle Rock Stadium
entities.source_summary: Former stadium converted into a cargo-container residential community; nearby drinking and gang tolls are external to the settlement rather than businesses operated by it.

entities.name: The Island
entities.source_summary: Fortified Voodoo Boys headquarters with internal drug stores, armory and tightly controlled provisioning for dependents; these are gang-internal resources and coercive support rather than public commerce.
